authorization: user, 7 Nov 2026: specials less likely in every slot; after the console migration: rare slot gold 10% / silver 4% / bronze 2% (Ultimate Pack averages about 3) and non-rare slots capped at 1% / 0.4% / 0.2% ("with non rare 1% it's good"); applies to regular and weighted packs
rule: Specials fill the slot kind of their base card. Per tier, a rare slot is a special with chance min(rare rate, s_rare), where s_rare is the specials' share of the rare pool; a non-rare slot with chance min(non-rare rate, k * s_common), k = rare chance / s_rare. Each slot decides special-or-not first, then the usual deterministic rank picks within that subset (weighted packs scale special weights to the same chance).
activation: set active true only in the console-specials migration, after the draw history is sealed
